record.title: The first year after planting
record.why: Every case study and "How a planting plan comes together" stop at handover or jump to "Two winters in", and nothing tells a client what to expect, or do, in between.
record.notes: Open on the call clients make in the first August, when everything looks smaller than the drawing. Cover watering until plants establish, weeding the gaps, what to leave alone, and why the first year looks thin (it's meant to). Keep it practical with short headings by season. [Need: the studio's own aftercare advice, and whether it offers follow-up visits.]
